item.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
item.description: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/using-codex-chatgpt-to-search-for-new-antimicrobials

item.title: Now everyone can put data to work
item.description: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/put-data-to-work

item.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
item.description: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/expanding-ai-access-us-government

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
item.description: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services

item.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
item.description: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live-1-in-the-api

item.title: Introducing the Agents API
item.description: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-agents-api

item.title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
item.description: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/paul-christiano-joins-openai-foundation-board

item.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
item.description: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra-next-generation-work

item.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
item.description: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/codex-quantum-computing-experiments

item.title: The Work Now Within Reach
item.description: Explore how more capable, affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish—and make growth more economical. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/the-work-now-within-reach

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
item.description: ChatGPT Images 2.5 helps turn your ideas, sketches, and reference photos into more personalized, polished images that better reflect your ideas. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-images-2-5

item.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
item.description: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/navier-stokes-solution

item.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
item.description: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/teen-development-research-grants

item.title: 1Password increases engineering productivity 21% with Codex
item.description: Engineers at 1Password use Codex to rapidly build new features and internal tools, reaching production-readiness while maintaining rigorous security policies. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/1password

item.title: OpenAI expands initiatives to support journalism from classrooms to newsrooms
item.description: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/supporting-journalism-from-classrooms-to-newsrooms

item.title: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
item.description: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/supporting-independent-journalism-in-ukraine

item.title: An Alien Mind
item.description: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned. He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind

item.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
item.description: Inside OpenAI, coding agents are reshaping AI research. Explore early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity, and research acceleration. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/research-acceleration-view-inside-openai

item.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
item.description: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/daybreak-for-frontline-defenders

item.title: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/legora-financial-statement-review-with-astra

item.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/playco-game-prototyping-with-astra

item.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
item.description: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/safety-overview-gpt-6-astra
